title: Shorten time to value in onboarding
summary: New users decide quickly whether a product is worth it. Find the first moment they get real value, and remove every step that stands between sign-up and that moment.

beginner: Define your activation event: the first action that shows a user got value.
Measure how long new users take to reach it, and how many do.
List every step between sign-up and that event.
Remove or delay steps that are not needed yet.
Test the shorter path and compare activation rates.
intermediate: Find the activation event that best predicts retention.
Design different paths for different user goals.
Use prompts and messages to bring back users who stall.
experienced: Set activation targets across products and segments.
Link activation to retention and revenue in planning.
Balance self-serve onboarding with sales or support help for complex products.

canDelegateTo.task: Measure activation rate and time to value

toolExamples.amplitude: Build a funnel from sign-up to activation.
toolExamples.mixpanel: Measure time to the activation event.

pitfalls: Measuring tour completion instead of value
One path for every kind of user
